TECHNICAL OVERVIEW

What Is A
Boiler Pump?

A Boiler Circulation Pump is a high-pressure centrifugal pump installed within the boiler circuit of a steam power plant — maintaining forced circulation of water through the evaporator tubes and boiler drum.

SYSTEM REHABILITATION

BCP Overhauling

BCPs typically operate under extreme conditions: system pressures from 100 to 200+ bar, water temperatures approaching saturation point, and continuous duty cycles with minimal planned downtime.

Most modern BCPs use a canned motor or wet motor design where the rotor operates submerged in process fluid — eliminating mechanical shaft seals and associated leak risk at high pressures.

DEI VOX CAPABILITIES

BCP Specialist
Services.

A comprehensive suite of services around the Boiler Circulation Pump lifecycle — built on direct field experience across multiple plant types and pump configurations.

BCP Overhauling

Complete strip-down, component inspection, dimensional measurement, and restoration to original tolerances. Includes impeller reconditioning, bearing replacement, can liner inspection, and full-load performance testing.

In-Situ Casing Machining

Precision in-situ machining of pump casings without removing them from the boiler piping — minimising plant outage time and risk when BCP casings develop leaks at flange faces or body joints.

Motor Rewinding

Rewind of canned motor stators using high-temperature insulation rated for continuous immersion in hot process water. All rewinds are tested to IEC standards with IR, hi-pot, and surge comparison testing.

Spare Parts & Reverse Engineering

OEM spare parts for older BCP models are frequently discontinued. DEI VOX uses reverse engineering to recreate precise dimensional replicas of impellers, wear rings, bearing housings, and can liners.

MAINTENANCE FRAMEWORK

BCP Maintenance
Best Practices.

01

Continuous Condition Monitoring

Vibration, temperature, and differential pressure trending to detect bearing degradation or flow disturbances early.

02

Water Chemistry Control

Maintain oxygen levels, pH, and conductivity within boiler water quality standards to minimise corrosion of motor internals.

03

Planned Overhauls

At OEM-recommended intervals or based on condition trigger points — typically every 30,000–40,000 operating hours.

04

Wear Component Replacement

Wear rings, thrust bearings, can liner integrity checks at each planned outage to maintain OEM-spec clearances.

05

Emergency Response

24/7 on-site support when pump trips or abnormal performance is detected. DEI VOX mobilises within 24–48 hours anywhere in India.

FREQUENTLY ASKED

BCP
Questions.

Q1

What is a Boiler Circulation Pump (BCP)?

A BCP is a specialised centrifugal pump that circulates water through the boiler drum and evaporator tubes of a high-pressure steam boiler. It maintains controlled water flow rates to ensure uniform heat transfer, prevent tube overheating, and protect the boiler from thermal stress.

Q2

How often should a Boiler Circulation Pump be overhauled?

Typical overhaul intervals range from 30,000 to 40,000 operating hours depending on water chemistry, operating pressures, and manufacturer recommendations. DEI VOX recommends a condition-based maintenance approach with regular vibration monitoring and physical inspections.

Q3

Can DEI VOX repair BCPs of all major manufacturers?

Yes. DEI VOX has extensive experience as NON-OEM in the repair, overhauling, and servicing of Boiler Circulation Pumps (BCPs) across power utilities, covering equipment from leading manufacturers such as KSB, Hayward Tyler, Fuji, V-FLO, Sulzer, and Torishima. As a provider of Alternative BCP Solutions, DEI VOX leverages its reverse engineering and in-house technical capabilities to develop and supply technically compatible replacement components for legacy and hard-to-source pump models.
